name: funding_hot
plain: Coin's funding is strictly above the interpolated 80th percentile of the scanned coins' funding.

invariants.why: top quintile: ~20% of scanned coins at most

implementations.label: scanner.run funding_hot block
implementations.note: Strictly ABOVE the cut (HL default-funding ties; '>=' flagged ~85% of coins). Tested by laptop SIZE_FLAGS / FUNDING_STOP_AUDIT with exactly this definition (definition-sensitive).
